intro: Denny's is America's Diner, open around the clock and famous for serving breakfast any time of day. The Grand Slam, where you build your own plate of pancakes, eggs, bacon and sausage, is the signature, alongside Moons Over My Hammy, burgers, melts and all-day dinners. Below is the full Denny's menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: Denny's is America's diner, serving breakfast all day. The Original Grand Slam is about $12.79, the Build Your Own Grand Slam is $11.99, and the Everyday Value Slam starts at just $5.99. Signature items like Moons Over My Hammy ($12.69) and the Lumberjack Slam ($14.69) round out the breakfast menu.
hot_deal: Denny's value: the Everyday Value Slam starts at just $5.99, and the Everyday Value Menu runs several full meals from $5.99 to $9.99, including a quarter-pound cheeseburger and a BLT. Denny's also has a rewards program with a birthday freebie. Offers vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a Grand Slam at Denny's?
faqs.a: The Original Grand Slam is about $12.79, and the Build Your Own Grand Slam, where you pick any four breakfast items, is around $11.99. The bigger Lumberjack Slam is about $14.69.

faqs.q: Does Denny's serve breakfast all day?
faqs.a: Yes. Denny's is America's Diner and serves its full breakfast menu around the clock, so you can order a Grand Slam or pancakes any time of day or night.

faqs.q: What is Moons Over My Hammy?
faqs.a: Moons Over My Hammy is a Denny's signature: scrambled eggs and ham grilled on sourdough with Swiss and American cheese. It is about $12.69 and roughly 760 calories.
Yes. The Everyday Value Slam starts at just $5.99, and the Everyday Value Menu has full meals from $5.99 to $9.99, including a quarter-pound cheeseburger and a BLT.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Denny's?
faqs.a: The best known are the Original Grand Slam, Moons Over My Hammy, the Lumberjack Slam, Country-Fried Steak, and the Build Your Own Grand Slam.
